description: This file defines application configuration settings for the backend, including environment variable handling, and logic for resolving database connection strings. It primarily provides a Settings dataclass and functions to load environment variables with fallbacks, with special handling for PostgreSQL DSN resolution.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing application configurations loaded from environment variables or fallback sources.

methods.name: str|None _get_env_any(names: list[str])
methods.description: Searches for the first available environment variable in a list of names and returns its value or None.

methods.name: str _get_env_required_any(names: list[str])
methods.description: Retrieves a required environment variable from a list of names, raising an error if none are found.

methods.name: int _get_env_int_any(names: list[str], default: int)
methods.description: Retrieves an environment variable as an integer from a list of names, with a default fallback.

methods.name: list[str] _get_env_csv_any(names: list[str], default: str)
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable(s) and parses as list of strings, separated by commas.

methods.name: str _resolve_postgres_dsn()
methods.description: Resolves the PostgreSQL DSN using environment variables or a configuration file, with a specific resolution order.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Public function to load application settings from environment variables, including PostgreSQL DSN, JWT secrets, and CORS origins.
